title: Annotatio II §.V: Ubiquity drawn to ease corporeal Coena defense — afterward neglected
pass_a_gloss: it having been brought in for that purpose, so that he might be able to defend the corporeal presence of Christ's Body in the Holy Supper so much the more easily, but afterward neglected,
pass_b_english: He brought ubiquity in so he could defend a corporeal presence of Christ's body in the Holy Supper more easily — then later let it drop.
source_text: eam in rem adductam, ut corporalem in Coena S. Corporis Christi praesentiam tantò faciliùs defendere valeret, sed posteà neglectam,
notes: Hexades Annotatio II §.V densify section 184; Pass A!=B; locked PDF ~244 / Hexades (64).
